lines: State activated by using Hidden Comet and provides the following effects:
* User's Max HP -50%
* User has a chance to dodge attacks according to the difference in speed between the attacking enemy and the user (Up to 90%)
* Stacks one Unshadowed when the user dodges an attack (Max Stack: 10)
* Dispels after 5 turns
* When dispelled consumes all Unshadowed
